# Fallout 76 - Patch notes January 30, 2024 (Patch 49)

![Fallout 76 - Patch notes 01/30/2024 (Patch 49)](/uploads/294_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update January 31, 2024]: Note on “Rasend”. The patch notes are misleading here. "Rasend" still grants a maximum bonus of 45% not 90%, it was fixed that before the patch only 90% of the 45% was granted as a bonus instead of the full 45%.

Today is our latest update for Fallout 76, bringing with it a slew of gameplay improvements, bug fixes, and more. Read on to find out the full patch notes for today's update.

UPDATE VERSION 1.7.9.7Here you can find out the download size of today's patch on the respective platform:

**PC (Steam):** 7.2 GB
**PC (Microsoft Store):** 11.5 GB
**PlayStation:** 7.8GB
**Xbox:** 1.6GB

BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTSC.A.M.P. AND WORKSHOP

**Slots:** The West Virginia slot now correctly states that it requires 25 caps to use. Additionally, a bug that caused players to receive perfectly preserved pies more often than intended has been fixed.
**Construction:** Players can now build the following C.A.M.P. objects again: Jewelry Skin Display Case, Flamethrower Napalm Tank, Wendigo Trophy, Beer Mug Display Case, Communist Bunker, Communist Fence.
**Switches:** The cost of any switch has been adjusted to be more consistent with other switches.CHALLENGES

**Daily Challenges:** Birthday Cake now contributes to the Daily Challenge "Eat a Cake, Pie, or Candy."
**Daily Challenges:** Fixed a bug where killed feral ghouls did not contribute to the daily challenge that required killing feral ghouls.
**Daily Challenges:** Plastic Gas Canisters now contribute to the Daily Challenge "Collect a Fuel Tank or Gas Canister."CRAFT

**Items:** Candy Bags, Gifts, and Miner's Buckets now provide contextual ammo.

- NOTE: For balancing reasons, we have removed contextual ammo and tokens from rewards in the past. After evaluating player feedback and analyzing our game economy, we have now added contextual ammunition again. Notes can be dropped by enemies. However, they are no longer part of items that can be crafted by players.
**Items:** Players can now again craft the following items: Vault-Tec Suit, Communist Combat Outfit, Communist Combat Hat, Communist Spy Ski Cap, Communist Spy Ski Outfit, Battle Rifle Paint (Communist Menace), Homemade Rifle Paint (Communist), Secret Service Underarmor (Communist Red), Communist Space Suit.
**Scout Armor Masks:** Scout Armor Masks with Covert Op, Forest Green, and Granite Gray can now be painted correctly and reverted to their original paint finish. Fixed the duplication of the No Paint option on the Granite Gray Scout Armor.
**Blueprints:** The Star Lamp's display name is now displayed correctly and visibly when obtained, learned, and crafted.
**Blueprints:** Fixed an issue where players could still purchase the Slot Machine Pedestal blueprint from Giuseppe after they had already learned the blueprint.
**Weapons:** Modifying Ultracite Lasers with the Beam Focuser mod no longer removes the visual effects.
**Legendary Mods:** Fixed a bug that caused the Legendary Mod of Frenzy to deal a maximum damage bonus of 45% on consecutive hits instead of the intended 90%.

Note on "Rasend". The patch notes are misleading here. “Frenzied” selected
